question: 上个月的GMV是多少
goldSql: SELECT SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv FROM public.orders WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question: 华东区各渠道的有效订单量
goldSql: SELECT channel, COUNT(order_id) AS order_cnt FROM public.orders WHERE region = 'east' AND order_status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY order_cnt DESC

question: 近30天每天的销售额趋势
goldSql: SELECT order_date, SUM(gmv) AS daily_gmv FROM public.orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - interval '29 days' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date

question: 销售额TOP10的商品
goldSql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.item_amount) AS sales FROM public.order_items i JOIN public.dim_products p ON i.sku_id = p.sku_id JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各城市等级的月活跃用户数
goldSql: SELECT u.city_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS mau FROM public.orders o JOIN public.dim_users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN (1,2,3) AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY u.city_level

question: 自营商品的退款率
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status = 5)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.order_status IN (1,2,3,5)), 0) AS refund_rate FROM public.orders o JOIN public.order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN public.dim_products p ON i.sku_id = p.sku_id WHERE p.is_self_operated = 1

question: 本月客单价
goldSql: SELECT SUM(gmv) / NULLIF(COUNT(order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_status IN (1,2,3)), 0) AS atv FROM public.orders WHERE order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

question: 各一级类目的销量占比
goldSql: SELECT p.category_l1, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty, SUM(i.quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(i.quantity)) OVER (), 0) AS ratio FROM public.order_items i JOIN public.dim_products p ON i.sku_id = p.sku_id JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY p.category_l1 ORDER BY qty DESC

question: 昨天的浏览到下单转化率
goldSql: WITH viewers AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM public.user_behavior WHERE event_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 AND event_type = 'view'), buyers AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buy_uv FROM public.orders WHERE order_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1 AND order_status IN (1,2,3)) SELECT buyers.buy_uv::numeric / NULLIF(viewers.uv, 0) AS cvr FROM viewers, buyers

question: 复购率是多少（今年）
goldSql: WITH user_orders AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(order_id) AS order_cnt FROM public.orders WHERE order_status IN (1,2,3) AND order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY user_id) SELECT COUNT(user_id) FILTER (WHERE order_cnt >= 2)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(user_id), 0) AS repurchase_rate FROM user_orders
